question: Why is this a conflict?
summary: This is a conflict because the SEBI circular requires a new certification (NISM Series‑V‑D) for persons selling or distributing SIFs and states that holding NISM Series XIII “shall not be applicable after September 21, 2026” (with limited transitional relief), while Nimbus’s internal policy (POL-002) requires NISM Series XIII (in addition to Series V-A) for selling Nimbus SIF strategies and does not require Series‑V‑D. SEBI text: "Any persons employed or engaged or to be employed or engaged in the sale and/or distribution of SIF products shall be required to have a valid \"NISM Series-V-D - Mutual Fund - Specialized Investment Fund Distributors Certification\"." Policy text: "POL-002 — Distributor Empanelment and Certification Policy §4.2 Specialized Investment Fund strategies Persons selling or distributing Nimbus SIF strategies must hold, in addition to NISM Series V-A, a valid NISM Series XIII Common Derivat…"

points.claim: SEBI requires NISM Series-V-D for persons selling/distributing SIFs and removes the applicability of NISM Series XIII after September 21, 2026 (with narrow transitional relief), while POL-002 requires NISM Series XIII (plus NISM Series V-A) for Nimbus SIF distributors and does not require Series-V-D, creating a direct conflict between the regulator obligation and the internal policy.
